Inbound SMB lead from sales enablement tool - call-summary/transcription app targeting SMB call centers. Short, fragmented notes below:

- Security: 'We need to be careful with PII' - CTO. Wants auto-delete and retention controls; legal team will require deletion proof for customer opt-outs.
- Asked if Redwood stores raw transcripts by default and for how long; also asked about ability to disable retention entirely.
- Interested in Hosted API (self-serve) to move fast; likely will evaluate Dedicated only if volume justifies.
- Requested sample SLA/pricing for ~100k tokens/mo and quick guide on retention API and audit logs.
- Quote from call: "If we can't show customers we deleted their data, legal won't sign off."
- Technical ask: need simple server-side call flow example that strips PII before storage; also asked about ability to route to model variants for cost savings.
- Next: send retention/PII playbook + example delete webhook; propose 30-min technical review w/ SE (Diego) wk of 2026-03-08.
- Risk: SMB legal resources limited; long legal review could push to Q3.
- Good fit: likes quick self-serve onboarding; Redwood's hosted pricing could work if token economics are competitive.
